_doc: School structure (shared world state in multiplayer). levels: the six levels and their arms; every arm is a class with its own classroom map (generated from the classroom template), form teacher, captain, timetable, register, seating and noticeboard. periods: how many periods each subject gets per week. A subject listed under 'split' is taught to groups at the same time (religion: CRS/IRS, lang: Yoruba/Igbo/Hausa, dept: SS departmental lines). SS levels have core subjects per arm plus 'lines': in a line period the whole level splits by department and each department group goes to its own room. rooms: where a split group meets (an arm's own room unless stated). The timetable for every arm is generated once per school (js/systems/school.js) so no teacher or room is booked twice.
classNotices: Class dues: ₦200 per head. See the class captain. 💰
Sweeping rota: Monday — Row 1, Tuesday — Row 2, Wednesday — Row 3, Thursday — Row 4. NO EXCUSE.
Anybody wey lose biro, check the lost & found under the teacher's table. 🖊️
Noisemakers' list will be submitted to the form teacher every Friday. 📝

bots._doc: Bot students fill empty desks when the dev/test setting fill_with_bot_students is on (off by default — students are meant to be real players). perArm: how many bots sit in each class arm.
